result.instructions: Tools for RetailCloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our products are low on stock?"; "Show the orders that have not shipped yet, with their UIIDs."; "Add tracking number AAA2223333WW2 from carrier UPS to order UG1-123456789 and mark it shipped.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RetailCloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run retailcloudpos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run retailcloudpos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run retailcloudpos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. retailcloudpos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List your products with their variants, SKUs, prices, cost, inventory and published status (true when a buyer published the product to the storefront). Read-only. Uses GET /v2/products.

limit.description: Products per page (up to 10000). The vendor default is 10000; the docs recommend 1000.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders to fulfill, with UIID, customer shipping address, SKU, quantity, cost, order date and personalization. Shipped orders are left out unless include_shipped is true. Read-only. Uses GET /v2/orders.

start_date.description: Start of the order date range: yyyy-mm-dd, or ISO 8601 with an offset (for example 2026-01-01T08:00:00-07:00). A date without an offset is read as GMT, then converted to Pacific Time.

end_date.description: End of the order date range: yyyy-mm-dd, or ISO 8601 with an offset (for example 2026-01-01T08:00:00-07:00). A date without an offset is read as GMT, then converted to Pacific Time.

include_shipped.description: Include orders that already shipped (default false).

tools.name: retailcloudpos_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get purchase order
tools.description: Get the purchase order (PO) number that holds an order, by its UIID. RetailCloud issues POs each business day for the preceding period. Read-only. Uses GET /v2/po.

uiid.description: Order UIID to look up, for example UG1-123456789.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_create_products
tools.title: Create or update products
tools.description: Create products, or update a product that is still in offered status (same call). Maximum 250 products per request. A product with errors is not created; the others still are. New products stay offered until the buyer publishes them. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms the exact products. Uses POST /v2/products.

category.description: Google Merchant Center category path, for example 'Apparel & Accessories > Jewelry > Anklets'. At least the top level.

conditionDetail.description: Short condition note, for example 'Open Box' or 'Grade A'.

features.description: Feature bullet points for the storefront.

options.description: Option types for multi-variant products, for example ['Size', 'Color'].

sku.description: Your SKU for this variant. Must be unique.

shipping.description: Shipping dimensions. Width + height + depth must not exceed 165 inches.

option.description: Option values in the same order as the product options, for example ['Small', 'Red'].

price.description: Suggested retail price. RetailCloud sets the final selling price.

cost.description: Amount paid to you for one unit.

items.description: A sellable variant of a product.

url.description: Website where the customer requests warranty service.

duration.description: One of: 30 Day Warranty, 90 Day Warranty, 90 Day Manufacturer Warranty, 1 Year Manufacturer Warranty, 2 Year Manufacturer Warranty.

provider.description: Vendor, distributor or manufacturer that gives the warranty.

warranty.description: Warranty details shown on the storefront.

specifications.description: Specifications used in the storefront description.

primaryImageURL.description: Public image URL. RetailCloud downloads it. Dropbox links do not work.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_add_variants
tools.title: Add variants
tools.description: Add variants to an existing product. Give the SKU of one existing variant of that product. A product can hold at most 100 variants. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms. Uses POST /v2/variants.

sku.description: SKU of an existing variant of the product to extend.
Your SKU for this variant. Must be unique.

shipping.description: Shipping dimensions. Width + height + depth must not exceed 165 inches.

option.description: Option values in the same order as the product options, for example ['Small', 'Red'].

price.description: Suggested retail price. RetailCloud sets the final selling price.

cost.description: Amount paid to you for one unit.

items.description: A sellable variant of a product.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_update_inventory
tools.title: Update inventory, price and cost
tools.description: Update the quantity, suggested retail price or cost of variants, by your SKU. Set available to 0 to stop sales of a SKU. A cost increase removes the product from the site until the buyer approves it. Check open orders before you change inventory. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms. Uses PUT /v2/inventory.

updates.description: One entry per SKU. Give at least one of available, price or cost per entry.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_add_tracking
tools.title: Add tracking and mark shipped
tools.description: Add the tracking number and carrier to orders and mark them shipped. Call it only after the order has shipped. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms. Uses POST /v2/orders/fulfill.

date.description: Ship date and time, for example 2019-02-27 18:15:11.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with RetailCloud
prompts.description: What you can do with RetailCloud here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_products_that_are_low_on_stock
prompts.title: Find the products that are low on stock
prompts.description: List your products with their variants, SKUs, prices, cost and inventory. Check which products are published to the storefront.

prompts.name: review_the_orders_that_have_not_shipped_yet
prompts.title: Review the orders that have not shipped yet
prompts.description: List the orders to fulfill, with their UIID, shipping address, SKU and quantity. Look up the purchase order that holds an order by its UIID.

prompts.name: stop_sales_of_a_sku_or_change_its_stock_quantity
prompts.title: Stop sales of a SKU or change its stock quantity
prompts.description: Set the available quantity of a SKU. Set it to 0 to stop sales of that SKU. Check the open orders before you change inventory.

prompts.name: set_new_cost_or_suggested_prices_for_skus
prompts.title: Set new cost or suggested prices for SKUs
prompts.description: Update the cost or suggested retail price of variants by SKU. A cost increase removes the product from the site until the buyer approves it.

prompts.name: add_tracking_numbers_to_orders_that_shipped
prompts.title: Add tracking numbers to orders that shipped
prompts.description: Add the tracking number and carrier to shipped orders and mark them shipped. Use this only after the order has shipped.

prompts.name: add_products_and_variants_to_the_catalog
prompts.title: Add products and variants to the catalog
prompts.description: Create new products, or update products still in offered status. Add variants to an existing product by giving the SKU of one of its variants.
